scares.description: The old lady groans and appears suddenly beside Mun.
Mun walks slowly down a corridor, as she approaches a light there is a rattling noise behind her.
A woman suddenly appears while Mun is learning calligraphy. She asks “why are you sitting on my chair?” and lunges at Mun.
An elderly man appears in the lift with Mun.
Mun sees a dark figure standing behind Ying Ying.
